newsitem.title: USA: CBOE says NFT index options off to moderate start.
newsitem.headline: CBOE says NFT index options off to moderate start.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said its Morgan Stanley Multinational Company Index .NFT options had a moderately active opening day on Wednesday, with volume totalling 1,349 contracts.
NFT options are one of the first major products launched by the exchange since former Chicago Mercantile Exchange president Bill Brodsky took over the helm at CBOE last month.
"We were pleased, but not surprised, to see trading activity right away in NFT," Brodsky said in a statement.
NFT is a capitalization-weighted index composed of stocks of 50 U.S. companies that derive a substantial portion of their earnings from foreign income.
Brodsky said the firms as a group had significantly outperformed the overall stock market.

While Wednesday's NFT option volume would be dwarfed by turnover in options on established benchmark indexes like the S&P 100 .OEX, which trades some 190,000 contracts a day, a CBOE spokesperson said the popular Nasdaq 100 index .NDX options, which now trade about 13,000 contracts daily, had started below 1,000 on the opening day.
The underlying NFT index ended down 3.69 points at 414.81.
